### VietLab v1.0.0 - Phat hanh chinh thuc

- Quan ly va giam sat phong may mang LAN chuyen nghiep.
- Nhan dien may tram tu dong qua UDP Beacon khong can cau hinh IP tinh.
- Dieu khien, khoa/mo man hinh, truyen phat file va mo cong thi truc tuyen VietTest.
- Dang nhap SSO dong bo voi toan he sinh thai VietApps.
- Toi uu hoa bo cai: Tach rieng bo cai May Giao Vien va May Hoc Sinh.
